```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(caret)
library(pROC)

datos <- read_excel("data.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(-count, -country, -state) %>%
  mutate(total_charges = na_if(str_trim(total_charges), "") %>% as.numeric())

# --- paleta (dataviz skill: referencia validada) ---
col_blue     <- "#2a78d6"
col_good     <- "#0ca30c"
col_critical <- "#d03b3b"
col_ink      <- "#0b0b0b"
col_ink2     <- "#52514e"
col_muted    <- "#898781"
col_grid     <- "#e1e0d9"
col_surface  <- "#fcfcfb"

theme_dash <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = col_grid, linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = col_ink2),
      axis.title         = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_blank(),
      legend.title        = element_blank(),
      strip.text         = element_text(color = col_ink, face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = col_surface, color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = col_surface, color = NA)
    )
}

# barra horizontal de tasa de churn por nivel de UNA variable categorica
bar_churn <- function(var, accuracy = 0.1) {
  d <- datos %>%
    group_by(nivel = .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(clientes = n(), tasa = mean(churn_value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(nivel = fct_reorder(nivel, tasa))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = tasa, y = nivel)) +
    geom_col(fill = col_blue, width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(tasa, accuracy = accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, size = 3.3, color = col_ink) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
    theme_dash()
}

# grilla de barras (facet) de tasa de churn por variable, para varias variables a la vez
facet_bar_churn <- function(vars, etiquetas, ncol = 2, accuracy = 0.1) {
  d <- datos %>%
    select(all_of(vars), churn_value) %>%
    pivot_longer(-churn_value, names_to = "variable", values_to = "nivel") %>%
    group_by(variable, nivel) %>%
    summarise(clientes = n(), tasa = mean(churn_value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      variable_lbl = recode(variable, !!!etiquetas),
      clave = fct_reorder(paste(variable, nivel, sep = "___"), tasa)
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(x = tasa, y = clave)) +
    geom_col(fill = col_blue, width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(tasa, accuracy = accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = col_ink) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^.*___", "", x)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))) +
    facet_wrap(~variable_lbl, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    theme_dash()
}

n_total     <- nrow(datos)
tasa_churn  <- mean(datos$churn_value)
tenure_prom <- mean(datos$tenure_months)
cltv_prom   <- mean(datos$cltv)

# --- modelo predictivo (mismo pipeline que Modelo.R / reporte_modelo.qmd) ---
set.seed(2026)

model_data <- datos %>%
  select(
    customer_id, churn_label,
    gender, senior_citizen, partner, dependents,
    tenure_months, phone_service, multiple_lines, internet_service,
    online_security, online_backup, device_protection, tech_support,
    streaming_tv, streaming_movies, contract, paperless_billing,
    payment_method, monthly_charges
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    churn_label = factor(churn_label, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    across(where(is.character) & !customer_id, as.factor)
  )

idx_train  <- createDataPartition(model_data$churn_label, p = 0.75, list = FALSE)
train_data <- model_data[idx_train, ] %>% select(-customer_id)
test_data  <- model_data[-idx_train, ] %>% select(-customer_id)

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = TRUE,
                      summaryFunction = twoClassSummary, savePredictions = "final")

modelo_glm <- train(churn_label ~ ., data = train_data, method = "glm",
                     family = "binomial", trControl = ctrl, metric = "ROC")

prob_test <- predict(modelo_glm, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
roc_glm   <- roc(test_data$churn_label, prob_test, levels = c("No", "Yes"), direction = "<")
umbral    <- as.numeric(coords(roc_glm, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold")$threshold)

pred_umbral <- factor(ifelse(prob_test > umbral, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
cm_umbral   <- confusionMatrix(pred_umbral, test_data$churn_label, positive = "Yes")

# probabilidad de churn para TODA la base (para el tablero de riesgo por cliente)
model_data$prob_churn <- predict(modelo_glm, model_data %>% select(-customer_id), type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

tabla_riesgo <- model_data %>%
  filter(churn_label == "No") %>%
  transmute(
    `ID cliente`     = customer_id,
    Contrato         = contract,
    Internet         = internet_service,
    `Método de pago` = payment_method,
    `Antigüedad (m)` = tenure_months,
    `Cargo mensual`  = dollar(monthly_charges),
    `Prob. de churn` = percent(prob_churn, accuracy = 0.1),
    Riesgo           = if_else(prob_churn > umbral, "Alto riesgo", "Bajo riesgo"),
    .prob            = prob_churn
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(.prob)) %>%
  select(-.prob)
```

## Row {height=78%}

```{r}
#| title: "Clientes por estado (activo vs. dado de baja)"
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4.2

d <- datos %>%
  count(churn_label) %>%
  mutate(
    churn_label = recode(churn_label, "No" = "Activo", "Yes" = "Dado de baja"),
    churn_label = fct_reorder(churn_label, n),
    pct = percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
  )

ggplot(d, aes(x = n, y = churn_label, fill = churn_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(n), " (", pct, ")")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.6, color = col_ink) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Activo" = col_good, "Dado de baja" = col_critical)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  theme_dash() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Antigüedad y cargo mensual según estado del cliente"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.2

datos %>%
  mutate(churn_label = recode(churn_label, "No" = "Activo", "Yes" = "Dado de baja")) %>%
  select(churn_label, tenure_months, monthly_charges) %>%
  pivot_longer(-churn_label, names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
                            tenure_months = "Antigüedad (meses)",
                            monthly_charges = "Cargo mensual (USD)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = churn_label, y = valor, fill = churn_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.25, width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Activo" = col_good, "Dado de baja" = col_critical)) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_dash() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(color = col_ink))
```

```{r}
  theme_dash() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = col_ink2, size = 10),
        legend.position = "right")

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
  plotly::config(displayModeBar = FALSE) %>%
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = "")))
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Curva ROC — regresión logística (set de test)"
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5

df_roc <- tibble(fpr = 1 - roc_glm$specificities, tpr = roc_glm$sensitivities)

ggplot(df_roc, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = col_grid, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(color = col_blue, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "1 − especificidad", y = "Sensibilidad") +
  theme_dash() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = col_ink2, size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Variables con efecto significativo sobre el riesgo de churn"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5

coefs <- summary(modelo_glm$finalModel)$coefficients %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)", `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(variable = fct_reorder(variable, Estimate))

ggplot(coefs, aes(Estimate, variable, fill = Estimate > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = col_ink2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = col_critical, "FALSE" = col_good), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Coeficiente (rojo = sube el riesgo, verde = lo baja)", y = NULL) +
  theme_dash() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = col_ink2, size = 10))
```
